# {{ site.person.name }}

> {{ site.person.name }} is a {{ site.person.job_title | downcase }}: eight years in print (2008 to 2016) and ten in software (2016 to now). Product work: first-of-their-kind software for regulated, high-stakes industries: energy, pharma, cybersecurity, payments and enterprise SaaS. Print work: art director at Counselor Magazine (ASHPE Bronze for best cover illustration) and the in-house book cover designer at Health Communications, Inc. (publisher of Chicken Soup for the Soul). Services offered: product design, graphic design (editorial, identity, print advertising) and book cover design for independent authors and small presses.

Contact: {{ site.person.email }}
